title: French Meme Song
blurb: A jaunty accordion-adjacent tune, and suddenly your clip is set in Paris regardless of where it was filmed. The internet reaches for this whenever something achieves Continental absurdity — a mime, a baguette carried at an angle, an elegant failure conducted with unwarranted dignity, or anybody being theatrically European in a way that would be embarrassing in English. It is an entire aesthetic delivered in about eight seconds, and it does more scene-setting than any caption could. Oui oui. Press the button and the video acquires a small moustache.
origin: The jaunty tune of French-flavored meme edits.
